title: Privacy Policy
translationNote: This translation is provided for convenience. If it differs from the English version of this policy, the English version applies.

summary.title: Summary
summary.body: Solitarius does not collect, store, or share any personal information. The app has no account system, no analytics, no advertising, and no server backend. The only thing that ever leaves your device is an anonymous crash report, sent when something goes wrong, and you can turn that off.

stored.title: Data stored on your device
stored.body: Solitarius saves your game statistics, favorites, settings, and in-progress games using on-device local storage. It is never sent to us or to any third party. If your device backs up its apps' data (on Android, to your Google account, if you have that turned on), a copy may be kept in that backup, which is handled under Google's privacy policy, not ours. The data is removed if you uninstall the app or clear its data.

collected.title: Data we collect
collected.body: Only crash diagnostics. When the app hits an error or crashes, it sends a report to Sentry, an error monitoring service, so the fault can be found and fixed. The report contains the error and the place in the app's code it came from, your device model, its operating system version and the app version, a short trail of what happened just before, such as which game was open, and, on Android, a random identifier created when the app was installed, so repeated reports from one installation can be counted together. That identifier is not linked to you, your account or your device, and a reinstall creates a new one. The report contains no name, email address, location, or any other personal information, and IP addresses are not stored. Turning off “Send crash reports” in the settings stops this entirely.

links.title: External links
links.body: A small number of screens include optional links to external websites (for example, photo attribution credits). Tapping one of these opens your device's web browser or the linked site directly. Solitarius has no control over, and is not responsible for, the privacy practices of those external sites.

children.title: Children's privacy
children.body: Solitarius does not knowingly collect any information from anyone, including children. It has no account system and asks for no personal details, and the crash diagnostics described above identify nobody.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: If this policy ever changes, an updated version will be published at this same address with a revised date above.
